adaptation: Minimal conversion subset rewritten around validated dictionaries. Preserves mixed user/tool-result content, forced tool choice and parallel-tool restrictions. Supports text-only mid-conversation system messages and turn-scoped clearing with linear history traversal. Rejects unsupported blocks, dynamic tool changes, malformed tool JSON, duplicate tool IDs, caller tool-constraint violations and inconsistent completion semantics in both response modes. Omits upstream environment loading, payload logging, model fallbacks, transport and HTTP routes. Streaming framing is implemented separately in proxy/server.py.
